task.title: Configuring a Red Hat Quay superuser
task.shortdesc: To configure a superuser account for your proof of concept Red Hat Quay deployment, you can add the SUPER_USERS array to config.yaml. Superusers can manage users, organizations, service keys, and global settings from the admin panel.

step.cmd: Add the SUPER_USERS array to the config.yaml file:

info.codeblock: SERVER_HOSTNAME: quay-server.example.com SETUP_COMPLETE: true SUPER_USERS: - quayadmin ...
